title: Answer: life regulating itself is the explanatory base

statements.text: Seth takes no position on fundamental physics. In his account the explanatory base for mind is a living body's drive to keep itself within viable bounds: perception, emotion and selfhood all derive from predictive regulation of the body.

sources.quote: all perceptual content is underpinned by inferential mechanisms that have a functional, ontological, and phylogenetic basis in allostasis.
